messages:
Priya N.: Uploading pen-test + vuln scan bundle for Acme vendor review. Zip includes: pen-test.pdf, nessus.xml, nmap.txt, remediation-tracker.csv, per-issue evidence, attestation draft. S3: https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/artifacts/acme_vuln_bundle_1787452100.zip
SHA256: 9f3b2a1c4d5e6f7a8b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2

SecurityBot: Scan summary (Nessus + nmap): Findings = 1 CRITICAL, 2 HIGH, 8 MEDIUM, 3 LOW. CSV includes CVE refs and mitigation suggestions. :mag:

Liam G.: Sales needs owner + team + ETA (YYYY-MM-DD) columns in tracker before we send. Also Acme requested InfoSec-signed attestation and confirmation about data exposure.

Priya N.: Added owner/team/ETA in remediation-tracker.csv. Sample rows below; full file updated in zip.
```
issue_id,desc,severity,owner,team,eta
AC-001,Open RDP on bastion,CRITICAL,Liam G.,Infra,2026-03-28
AC-017,Old OpenSSL,HIGH,Infra Team,Infra,2026-04-06
AC-024,Missing CSP,MEDIUM,Web Eng,Frontend,2026-03-31
```
Attestation draft in /attestation/acme_attestation_draft.pdf addressed to "Acme Corp (security@acme.example)". We will GPG-sign and timestamp.

Eve C.: For AC-001 I can remove the 0.0.0.0/0 rule and enforce SSM bastion access. I can perform the change tonight; ETA 2026-03-28 to include validation. Evidence filenames: AC-001-rdp-screenshot.png, AC-017-openssl-output.txt.

Liam G.: Added CHG-7982 change request link and on-call (pager@redwood.com). Confirmed initial review: no customer PII found in exported artifacts. We'll include that statement in the attestation.

Priya N.: Draft customer-facing summary: "Redwood completed an external penetration test and vulnerability scan for your environment. One critical finding has been scheduled for immediate remediation; remediation ownership, timelines, and supporting evidence are attached, along with a signed attestation confirming no customer data exposure."

SecurityBot: Reminder: retention for security artifacts is 90 days. If legal requests extended retention, open ticket in #legal.

Liam G.: I'll verify the remediation tracker after the change window tonight and mark confirmed.

Priya N.: I'll send to Acme tomorrow 09:00 PT with CHG-7982 and on-call contact. Closing thread unless other comments.
